questions.question: Antifreeze keeps an engine working properly:
questions.explanation: Your vehicle's cooling system needs enough water and antifreeze at all times. Despite its name, antifreeze helps your engine in hot weather too.

questions.question: A driver should always:

options.text: Drive faster than the speed limit.

questions.explanation: While driving, watch the road ahead for possible dangers. Plan how you will handle emergencies if they happen.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle, you should:
questions.explanation: Always set the parking brake when you leave your vehicle.

questions.question: A pre-trip inspection:

options.text: Should be done the same way every time.
Should be done differently every time.
Does not need to check all items every time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be done the same way every time.
questions.explanation: Do your pre-trip inspection the same way every time. This helps you remember all the steps and makes sure you don't miss anything.

questions.question: Which of the following shows you are drowsy while driving?

options.text: Your eyes blur or go out of focus on their own
You have trouble keeping your head up

questions.explanation: Signs of drowsy driving include eyes that blur or go out of focus on their own, trouble keeping your head up, and drifting between lanes.

questions.question: When a combination vehicle is lightly loaded:

options.text: Most weight should be in the rear of the trailer.

questions.explanation: A lightly-loaded combination vehicle may have poor traction. The wheels can easily lock up when you try to stop.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you will be asked to:

options.text: Explain to the examiner what you are checking and why.
Guess the weight of a trailer load.

questions.correctAnswerText: Explain to the examiner what you are checking and why.
questions.explanation: The vehicle inspection test requires you to do a complete inspection. You must explain what you are checking and why.

questions.question: The maximum air leakage for a single vehicle with air brakes is:
questions.explanation: Know the safe air loss rate for your vehicle. A single vehicle with air brakes should lose no more than 3 psi in one minute during an applied leakage test.

questions.question: When a trailer's wheels lock up:

options.text: The trailer tends to swing around.
The cab swings, but the trailer stays straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: The trailer tends to swing around.
questions.explanation: When a trailer's wheels lock up, the trailer may swing out and hit other vehicles. This is more likely with lightly-loaded trailers.

questions.question: If you are turning left and there are two left turn lanes, which should you use?

options.text: Trucks should not turn where there are two left turn lanes.

questions.explanation: A large vehicle may need to swing right to make a left turn. When an intersection has two left turn lanes, use the right lane to start your turn.

questions.question: Which one is not a type of retarder?
questions.explanation: Retarders are devices that help slow a vehicle and reduce brake wear. The four main types are exhaust, engine, hydraulic, and electric retarders.

questions.question: During a trip, which one does not need to be checked regularly?
questions.explanation: During a trip, regularly check your gauges, mirrors, tires, cargo, and lights. Look for any signs of trouble.

questions.question: Backing with a trailer is dangerous because:

options.text: The driver cannot see well behind the trailer.
There may be extra weight in the front of the vehicle.
Cargo may fall out of the trailer.
Trailers are not made to be driven in reverse.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver cannot see well behind the trailer.
questions.explanation: Backing is always dangerous because you cannot see everything behind your vehicle. Only back up if it is absolutely necessary.

questions.question: Before driving a vehicle with a dual air brake system, the air compressor must build at least ____ psi in both systems.
questions.explanation: Before driving a vehicle with a dual air brake system, wait for the air compressor to build at least 100 psi in both the primary and secondary systems.

questions.question: Which one is not a reason to use your mirrors?

options.text: You are looking at fuel prices.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are looking at fuel prices.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors regularly while driving. This is especially important when turning, changing lanes, merging, and making tight maneuvers.

questions.question: To prevent a rollover, cargo should be:

options.text: Loaded with most weight on the driver's side of the trailer.
Placed near the rear of the trailer.

questions.explanation: Spread cargo weight evenly in the trailer to prevent rollovers. Do not put too much weight on one side.

questions.question: When checking a coupling visually, you should:

options.text: Make sure there is no gap between the upper and lower fifth wheel.
Make sure the kingpin is polished.
Look for mud on the fifth wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure there is no gap between the upper and lower fifth wheel.
questions.explanation: When checking a coupling, make sure there is no gap between the upper and lower fifth wheel. Check that the locking jaws are closed tightly around the kingpin.

questions.question: What can happen if the exhaust system is not working properly?

options.text: Poisonous fumes may enter the cab.
Fumes may exit the rear of the muffler system.

questions.correctAnswerText: Poisonous fumes may enter the cab.
questions.explanation: Exhaust system leaks are very dangerous. They can allow toxic fumes into the cab or sleeper berth, which endangers drivers and passengers.

questions.question: If you must back a truck:

options.text: Rely only on your mirrors to guide you.
First walk the area to check for obstacles.

questions.correctAnswerText: First walk the area to check for obstacles.
questions.explanation: Before backing, walk around your vehicle to look at the path and check for obstacles. Mirrors have blind spots, so do not rely only on them. Use a helper whenever possible.

questions.question: Driving at night is:

options.text: Safer than driving during the day.
Just as safe as driving during the day.
More dangerous than driving during the day.

questions.correctAnswerText: More dangerous than driving during the day.
questions.explanation: Driving at night is more dangerous than driving during the day because it is harder to see hazards in the dark.
